Top candidates: **Common_Smut** or **Head_Smut**. Let me view one reference.

The reference Common_Smut image shows large galls with white-gray membrane and black interior spores on the ear — typical of *Ustilago maydis*.

The test image shows an ear with husk pulled back, exposing a large flat black spore mass. This matches Common Smut on the ear — the outer membrane has already ruptured, exposing the mature black teliospores. The morphology (on the ear, black powdery mass) is consistent with Common_Smut rather than Head_Smut (which typically replaces the tassel).
